compat: Plugin minimum: vfox {min_version}. Use current vfox for the commands in this guide.
install_title: A few commands. Then you’re in.
install_description: Check the platform requirements, then choose your version manager. The examples pin a version; search to find other available releases.
copy_error: Select the command and copy it manually
guide_title: From the first install to your daily run.
guide_project_title: Keep the version with the project
guide_project_text: Initialize vfox in Bash and select the project version. With mise, use mise use to select a version for the current project.
faq1_question: How do I find other versions?
faq4_question: How do I update the plugin?
closing_text: Find the source, report an issue or explore the releases on GitHub.
footer_text: An independent vfox plugin documentation site.
hero_description: Manage Elixir with vfox or mise, with clear Erlang/OTP dependencies and project versions. Choose source builds, Windows installation or Hex prebuilt packages.
feature1_text: Elixir builds depend on Erlang/OTP. The plugin declares this dependency; choose a compatible OTP version before installation.
feature2_text: Install from source by default, or use Hex builds with VFOX_ELIXIR_MIRROR=hex.
feature3_text: Install Elixir through vfox or mise and run elixir, elixirc and mix.
linux_deps: Install compatible Erlang/OTP first. Source builds also need Make and build tools.
macos_deps: Prepare Erlang/OTP and Xcode Command Line Tools. See the Erlang plugin for OTP build dependencies.
windows_deps: Install Erlang/OTP first. Use vfox 0.5.3+. Windows installation supports Elixir 1.15 and later, with an OTP suffix in the version name.
guide_tools_text: Use the same mirror option for search and installation, and choose a build matching your installed OTP.
guide3_title: Match the OTP version on Windows
guide3_text: Activate Erlang first, then install an Elixir version with an OTP suffix. This example pairs Elixir 1.16.2 with OTP 26.
guide3_detail: Use vfox search elixir to find available version names.
guide3_note: Prebuilt packages still require compatible Erlang/OTP. Avoid incompatible OTP major versions.
faq2_answer: Elixir runs on the Erlang VM, and source builds require Erlang tools. Choose versions using the official compatibility table.
faq3_question: Do Hex prebuilt packages still need OTP?
faq3_answer: Yes. The otp-N suffix must match the Erlang/OTP major version in your runtime environment.
description: Manage Elixir with vfox or mise, with clear Erlang/OTP dependencies and project versions. Choose source builds, Windows installation or Hex prebuilt packages.
faq1_answer: Run vfox search elixir or mise ls-remote vfox:version-fox/vfox-elixir to find available versions.
faq4_answer: Run vfox update elixir. The plugin checks the manifest published in this repository.
